update_v111_title: Unified Smart Assistant Triggers & Bulk Data Hardening
update_v111_desc: We have introduced deep AI integration across the entire manager management suite:
update_v111_b1: Universal Smart Assistant Buttons: Integrated dedicated 'Smart Assistant' triggers directly into the Driver, Vehicle, and Shipment registration sections.
update_v111_b2: Guided Conversational Flow: The chatbot now leads you through a step-by-step interactive dialogue to collect information.
update_v111_b3: Redefined Bulk Upload Infrastructure: Extensively audited and optimized the Bulk Upload features for Shipments, Drivers, and Vehicles.
update_v111_b4: Safety Intelligence Capture: The interactive flow now seamlessly incorporates safety-critical driver metrics.
update_v111_impact_desc: This version focuses on making the platform more accessible and precision-oriented:
update_v111_i1: Enhanced Interactivity: Moving away from static forms makes the platform significantly more user-friendly.
update_v111_i2: Precision & Accuracy: Guided flows eliminate guesswork. Interactive dropdowns and automated formatting ensure accuracy.
update_v111_i3: Accelerated Operations: Integrated map pickers and strictly enforced dropdowns enable much faster data entry.
update_v111_i4: Verified Bulk Reliability: Redefined bulk tools ensure scaling your fleet is a smooth, error-free experience.
update_v101_title: Advanced Fleet Oversight & Granular Data Control
update_v101_desc: We have significantly enhanced the fleet management module to provide deeper operational insights and smoother data management:
update_v101_b1: Enhanced Driver Registry: The drivers table now includes dedicated columns for License Type and Past Accidents.
update_v101_b2: Refined Data Display: Removed redundant fields like vehicle passwords to keep the interface focused.
update_v101_b3: Intelligent Input Controls: Upgraded the Edit Modules for both drivers and vehicles.
update_v101_b4: Consolidated Communication: Simplified driver registration by merging duplicate phone sections.
update_v101_b5: Comprehensive CRUD Oversight: Managers now have full authority to edit every system field.
update_v101_impact_desc: These refinements translate to measurable improvements for our core user base:
update_v101_i1: For Fleet Managers: Faster decision-making with enriched data tables.
update_v101_i2: For Data Administrators: Drastic reduction in data entry errors.
update_v101_i3: For Support Teams: Improved troubleshooting efficiency.
update_v100_desc: Welcome to the first version of Logistix. After extensive development, we are proud to present a fully digital, cashless, and AI-optimized logistics infrastructure.
hero_desc: The world's first fully digital, cashless, and Automated-optimized supply chain infrastructure.

update_v112_desc: We have achieved full linguistic parity across the entire Logistix platform. Managers, drivers, and customers can now interact with the portal in their native regional languages.
update_v112_b1: 15+ Regional Languages: Added full support for Hindi, Bengali, Gujarati, Telugu, Tamil, Marathi, Kannada, Malayalam, Odia, Punjabi, Assamese, Maithili, Santali, and Kashmiri.
update_v112_b2: End-to-End Localization: Every dashboard, table header, button, and system notification has been localized to eliminate English placeholders.
update_v112_b3: Dynamic Registry Sync: Introduced a centralized translation engine that ensures real-time UI updates when switching languages without page reloads.
update_v112_b4: Localized Help & Voice: Hands-free voice commands and help guides are now available in all supported regional dialects for safer driver operations.
update_v112_impact_desc: This update breaks down linguistic barriers, making professional logistics management accessible to everyone:
update_v112_i1: Universal Access: Users from all regions of India can now access the portal more freely and confidently in their mother tongue.
update_v112_i2: Operational Inclusion: Drivers who were previously restricted by English-only interfaces can now navigate, report incidents, and manage their wallets independently.
update_v112_i3: Reduced Friction: Localized financial headers and smart contract terms ensure transparency and trust in multi-party transactions.
update_v112_i4: Global Standards, Local Feel: Combines world-class logistics technology with a deeply rooted regional experience for every user.
otp_wait_msg: Please wait for the timer to finish before requesting again.
update_v113_desc: This update introduces autonomous drone fleets as a primary transportation mode and fortifies account security:
update_v113_b1: Drone Fleet Management: Drones are now a first-class transportation mode with dedicated registration, license tracking, and bulk upload support.
update_v113_b2: Smart Drone Assistant: Onboard drones through a guided step-by-step chat interface integrated into the Smart Assistant.
update_v113_b3: Improved OTP Reliability: Resolved system hanging issues in OTP requests across signup, account deletion, and tracking flows.
update_v113_b4: Secure Account Deletion: Account removal now requires multi-factor verification with manager password and OTP for maximum security.
update_v113_impact_desc: Users will benefit from a more versatile fleet and a more reliable authentication experience:
update_v113_i1: Versatile Logistics: Seamlessly manage both terrestrial and aerial assets from a unified 'Drivers & Fleet' dashboard.
update_v113_i2: Effortless Onboarding: Smart assistants guide you through complex registrations, eliminating data entry errors.
update_v113_i3: Reliable Authentication: Localized OTP messages and improved backend synchronization ensure you are never stuck during verification.
